recipes.title: Caramelised Roasted Sweet Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C / 375°F and line a baking tray or dish with baking paper.
Wash and dry the sweet potatoes, trim the ends and slice them in half lengthways.
Toss with the olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic and smoked paprika, making sure the cut sides are well coated.
Place cut side down and bake 50 minutes. Don't flip or move them.
Leave them on the tray 30–45 minutes if you can (even 10 helps) so the caramelised layer stays on the potato instead of the paper.
Lift carefully with a thin spatula, caramelised side up.
recipes.notes: Recipe comes from the video description. Nutrition per half is an estimate; the creator didn't list it. Cook time doesn't include the optional rest.
